title: Aggregate biomarker/outcome assertion extraction (expert-verified, not advice)
context: This task extracts only aggregate biomarker/outcome statements, each source-spanned and aggregate-only, with domain-expert verification. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. No patient-level data, no clinical advice, and no synthesis: this is faithful reporting of published aggregate findings, gated by the domain and License+PII reviewers.
objective: Extract aggregate biomarker/outcome assertions (expert-verified, source-spanned, aggregate-only) -- never advice.
acceptanceCriteria: Only aggregate research/biomarker/outcome statements extracted, each with a source span and aggregateOnly:true; no patient-level data, no clinical advice, no synthesis.
>= 100 assertions domain-expert verified for scientific faithfulness, each with reviewer attribution + timestamp recorded in verification.
License/PII reviewer confirms no ND full text or identifiable detail used.
